question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP initialize request (jsonrpc 2.0, protocolVersion 2025-06-18, clientInfo public-agents-researcher 1.0), then a tools/list on the same session, Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream

decoded.challenge: none: the 200 carries no www-authenticate header
decoded.tools-list: 200 with no session id issued: 2 tools (search_cloudflare_documentation, migrate_pages_to_workers_guide)
decoded.protected-resource-metadata: 404 ("Not Found") at https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp (the RFC 9728 path for the resource; nothing named it)
decoded.authorization-server-metadata: not looked for: step 2 named no authorization server
decoded.rest: not measured: the entry names no REST base URL; the Documentation server is the one keyless server of the vendor's set, and the account-scoped servers were not probed today

finding: With no credentials, an MCP initialize POST to docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp (the vendor's Documentation server, the entry's stated keyless surface) answers 200 (docs-ai-search 0.4.13), and a tools/list answers 200 with two tools: search_cloudflare_documentation and migrate_pages_to_workers_guide. No challenge is sent and the RFC 9728 default path answers 404, which is consistent with a server that has no authenticated mode. This probe measures the Documentation server only; the vendor's account-scoped servers (Workers bindings, observability and the rest) were measured on 2026-09-12 in the entry's notes and are not re-run today. Same 200 and same two tools as that 2026-09-12 measurement. Nothing here measures what a tool call returns.
